updates.title: Adaptive decks, independent Blur and UI fixes
updates.description: Implemented and locally tested: adaptive placement and labels for 1–5 decks; independent Word Blur, Picture Blur or Nothing remembered per deck between games; stable Reveal and Done / Continue controls; long-card scrolling; readable settings and revealed boost tiles across eight themes.
updates.homeSummary: Clearer decks and individual Blur settings

updates.title: Delta 9: cross-game content compatibility
updates.description: Implemented and locally tested: Card Decks and Sentence Correction in Tic-Tac-Toe; Sentence Correction and Bridges in Board Race. Shared task modals gate evaluation behind Reveal Answer; Bridges require all gaps and lock choices after reveal. Tic-Tac-Toe preserves Steal; graded Board Race moves only on Correct, including individual Team Up decisions. Existing authored materials remain unchanged.
updates.homeSummary: Use your activities in more games

updates.title: Delta 8: unified My Content library
updates.description: Implemented and locally tested: one grid for Concepts, Scenes, Card Decks, Bridges and Sentence Correction; shared one-level folders, previews and action menus; current-folder search, type filters and sorting. Cards open editors; Play is removed from the library. Move to… works without dragging; deleting a folder returns materials to the root. Existing local records, IDs and images are preserved.

updates.title: I Spy usability improvements
updates.description: Fixed magnifier dragging, enlarged the scene editing workspace, and improved direct Scene Editor navigation.

knownIssues.title: Dark theme contrast
knownIssues.description: Version 2.23.0 fixes settings/control contrast and revealed boost-tile colours, with local browser checks across eight themes. Live Pages verification is pending; player-name contrast from the original report has not been explicitly confirmed fixed.

roadmap.title: Simpler content editors

roadmap.title: Unified content library
roadmap.description: Delta 8 (2.21.0) implements the unified five-type library, shared folders, previews, filtering and sorting. Local checks passed and code was uploaded to GitHub; live Pages publication verification remains pending.

roadmap.title: Adaptive decks and Board Race UI fixes
roadmap.description: Version 2.23.0 is implemented and locally tested: adaptive decks, persistent per-deck Blur, stable card controls and theme fixes. Code is uploaded; live Pages verification and confirmation of the original player-name contrast report remain pending.
